judged_text: The removed `console.error` block logged the zod error and the raw Microsoft response on schema failure; the replacement throws a generic Error('Invalid refreshed tokens were returned') with no diagnostic detail, and it now aborts the refresh where the old code logged and continued. Operators debugging Outlook token failures lose the response body that explained the mismatch, and transient schema mismatches now fail the calendar operation instead of proceeding with the previous token.

adjudication.rationale: Verified in `packages/app-store/office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`: the prior code did `refreshTokenResponseSchema.safeParse(responseJson)` and, on failure, `console.error(...)` but did not throw; it proceeded to update using `tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data` (effectively leaving existing creds if parse failed). The new code calls `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)`, and `parseRefreshTokenResponse` throws `new Error("Invalid refreshed tokens were returned")` when parsing fails, without logging the raw Microsoft response or zod error. This is a real, diff-grounded observability/behavior change that can make Outlook token refresh failures harder to debug and changes failure mode (throw vs. log-and-continue).
